messages:
maria_marketing: Heads-up: Coastline AI case interview tomorrow 9am PT with their CTO. Need hero quote + logo permission + legal OK by Friday EOD to make next-Tues blog + webinar. Who can own assets and timeline?

tom_sdr: I can own inbound routing and nurture flows. Will tag leads campaign=coastline-case and route to Demo SDR. Need final publish URL by Mon EOD.

ivy_content: I'll handle ASR -> 1-pass human clean transcript + 3 social snippets. Please drop raw audio in shared drive immediately after call.

nate_se: I'll upload the raw recording and a 60s highlight clip with timestamps. Can also pull the demo mention around 12:34.

maria_marketing: Please ask Coastline to confirm the benchmark phrase "~2.5x throughput" during the interview and get that line in chat for legal. If they won't, we'll anonymize.

legal_team: Send any verbatim metric quotes + context to legal-review@redwood.com. We need provenance for quantified claims or we'll convert to qualitative language. Expect ~48h review.

ivy_content: Will mark transcript lines with [CLAIM: source needed] and flag the clip slate. Also will produce two hero copy options for legal to vet.

promo-bot: Reminder: embargo window set to 2026-04-05 09:00 PDT if legal clears by 2026-04-03 17:00.

tom_sdr: Quick ask: can someone draft a 1-line webinar hook for the signup? Short, benefit-forward.

maria_marketing: I'll draft 2 hooks and post here after the call. If legal redacts metrics, we'll run a qualitative headline and still open webinar registration. Thanks all — will update with raw link and clip timecodes after 9am call.
